## Checks

<!-- The output of `python3 apps/reasoning-demo/build.py --check`, the demo tests and `python3 scripts/check-website.py`. -->

A maintainer reviews a shared commons before it goes live: that the people named agreed, that it fits the site, and that it names no one who isn't part of it in connection with wrongdoing. Merging publishes it; it does not mean Reason Commons agrees with the reasoning.
